Markets.title: Bitcoin near $63K, Ethereum below $1,900 as softer US inflation fails to ease crypto market pressure
Markets.summary: Despite softer US inflation data, Bitcoin traded near $63,000 and Ethereum stayed below $1,900 amid continued market pressure. Subdued ETF flows and cautious investor sentiment weighed on the broader crypto market as traders awaited upcoming US PPI data.

Markets.title: Black Box Q1 net profit up 18% to Rs 56 crore
Markets.summary: Black Box reported an 18% increase in Q1 net profit to Rs 56 crore, driven by a strong order book and growth in Brazil. Revenue from operations surged 83% to a record Rs 1,719 crore, and the company plans to hire 3,000 new professionals.

Markets.title: IndiQube Spaces Q1 revenue jumps 37% to record Rs 428 crore
Markets.summary: IndiQube Spaces reported a 37% year-on-year increase in Q1FY27 revenue to a record ₹428 crore. During the same period, profit after tax surged 91% to ₹35 crore alongside expansions in managed area, seat capacity, and occupancy.

Markets.title: Shriram Properties Q1 profit down 46% to Rs 11 cr
Markets.summary: Shriram Properties reported a 46 percent drop in June quarter net profit to Rs 11 crore due to higher operational expenses and taxes. Despite the profit decline, total income rose slightly to Rs 271.04 crore and sales bookings increased by 10 percent to Rs 484 crore.

Markets.title: Fintech startup Navi said to hire banks for $315 million IPO
Markets.summary: Indian fintech startup Navi Ltd. is planning an initial public offering to raise up to $315 million. The company aims for a valuation of up to $2 billion and plans to file its paperwork by December.

Markets.title: Global Market: European stocks gain as lower oil prices offer relief amid Middle East tensions
Markets.summary: European stock markets edged slightly higher as falling oil prices provided some relief to investors. However, ongoing Middle East tensions and stalled US-Iran talks limited overall market gains.

Geo-Political.title: Putin can no longer claim victory in Ukraine, Nobel Peace Prize winner tells BBC
Geo-Political.summary: Nobel Peace Prize winner Dmitry Muratov told the BBC that Vladimir Putin can no longer claim victory in Ukraine. Muratov stated that the Kremlin leader can only destroy the country rather than conquer it, as the war enters its fifth year.

Geo-Political.summary: Additional troops are being deployed to the West Bank village of Qusra following a siege by Israeli settlers. Two Palestinian families report being trapped in their homes with their water and power cut off since Sunday.

Geo-Political.title: Ebola outbreak on track to be deadliest ever, WHO chief says
Geo-Political.summary: The WHO chief states that the Ebola outbreak, declared on May 15, is on track to become the deadliest ever. The epidemic has already caused over 2,000 deaths alongside thousands of reported cases.

Data & Insights.summary: India's retail inflation rose to 4.45% in July, staying above the Reserve Bank of India's 4% midpoint target for the second consecutive month. This increase was driven by higher food and fuel prices, while elevated global oil prices continue to pose risks.
